credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: Portrait of David McAlpin looking up at the camera, in a black and white plaid shirt, washing his hands with a bar of soap over a bowl on a wooden table, white plate and fork in foreground.This photograph is part of an album created by Ansel Adams after his 1938 trip to Yosemite with Georgia O'Keeffe, David McAlpin, and Helen and Godfrey Rockefeller. This is one of only three albums created for his travel companions documenting their trip.
title: Untitled (David McAlpin)
